guidance.statement: Deliver 60 million to 62 million new loans in FY27.
guidance.quote: We are well on track to deliver between 60 million to 62 million new loans in FY27.

guidance.statement: Add 18 million to 20 million customers to the franchise in FY27.
guidance.quote: We are clear about adding between 18 MM to 20 MM customers to the franchise in FY27.

guidance.statement: Deliver 25 to 40 basis points improvement in FY27 on opex-to-NTI.
guidance.quote: We remain pretty comfortable place to deliver a 25 to 40 basis point improvement in FY27 on opex-to-NTI.

guidance.statement: Deliver between 26% and 27% loan growth on a full year basis.
guidance.quote: I would say probably between 26%, 27% growth we should deliver now on a full year basis.

guidance.statement: Maintain medium term loan growth guidance of 20% to 25%.
guidance.quote: medium term, we maintain a guidance of 20% to 25% on a year lower here and a year higher there.

guidance.statement: See double-digit growth momentum in MSME business in the second half.
guidance.quote: we should start to see as we get in the second half, a double-digit kind of growth momentum in the business.

achieved.claim: AUM grew by 26.5% to INR 5,84,624 crores with net addition of INR 38,000 crores.
PBT grew by 29% to INR 8,537 crores in Q2.
PAT grew by 29% to INR 6,367 crores in Q2.
Cost of funds declined sequentially by 9 bps to 7.31% in Q2.

pushback.concern: Why aren't short-term gold loans offered despite lower LTV risk?
Why did MSME GNPA and overall GNPA increase during the quarter?
How will rate hikes impact margins and cost of funds?
How will regulatory changes in insurance and revolvers impact revenue?

output.tone_why: Management expressed strong conviction in secular growth, low credit costs, and robust capital position.
